record.title: Trending Jeans for Men in 2026: The Styles Worth Buying
record.meta_description: Discover trending jeans for men in 2026, including slim fit, relaxed fit, and denim jeans styles worth adding to your wardrobe from Spykar.
record.summary: Men's jeans in 2026 feature more relaxed fits and versatile styles, centering comfort without dropping fashion relevance. The article covers utility-led shapes and vintage washes as current buying considerations.
key_points: Relaxed-fit jeans are highlighted for comfort.
Cargo denim adds utility and a streetwear direction.
Wide-leg denim trousers reflect a Gen Z-led silhouette shift.
Vintage washes are returning in men's fashion.
